items.title: John Altman interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, September 14, 2023
items.q: Trevor Horn who produced it, in his new book, has explained how he did it

ctx.x: Wow. I have never heard of such a thing. And so it didn’t speed up the music.

No I don’t know how they did it. I mean Trevor Horn who produced it, in his new book, has explained how he did it, which there was some sort of film — something that was used by movie editors that he appropriated and he replaced the arrangement with synthesized — until the point where they could get it to actually sound like it should have done, and then they put back the original chart. I mean it wasn’t as simple as tweaking a knob and pushing the whole thing up a tone, or well a tone would have been a lot. But…
